US.description: Includes estimated federal income, FICA (Social Security & Medicare), and an average state income tax for an $85k earner.

IN.description: Includes central income tax based on progressive slabs and a 4% health and education cess, under the New Tax Regime.

SG.description: Effective income tax rate for an $85k USD earner. Singapore has a progressive tax system, and there is no capital gains tax.

CH.description: Includes federal, cantonal, and municipal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions, varying by canton and municipality.

NL.description: Includes income tax and mandatory social security contributions for an $85k USD equivalent earner in the Netherlands.

GB.description: Includes Income Tax and National Insurance contributions based on an average conversion rate from USD to GBP.

CA.description: Includes federal income tax, provincial income tax (Ontario), Canada Pension Plan (CPP), and Employment Insurance (EI) contributions for an $85k USD equivalent earner.

AE.description: The UAE has no personal income tax for individuals.

NO.description: Includes national income tax, municipal tax, and social security contributions for an $85k USD earner.

IE.description: Includes income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for an $85k USD equivalent earner.

LU.description: Effective rate includes progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions for pension, health, and long-term care insurance.

AU.description: Effective tax rate includes federal income tax (based on current Stage 3 tax cuts) and Medicare Levy for an income of approximately $127,500 AUD.

QA.description: No personal income tax for residents in Qatar.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam does not impose personal income tax on its residents or citizens.

MO.description: Includes Macao's Professional Tax, which is a low-rate progressive income tax with a generous initial exemption. There is no general sales tax or VAT.
